content: Upon manual inspection of the errors committed by the BERT-based model, we discovered that it has a slight tendency towards producing ill-formed BIO sequences (e.g, starting a sensitive span with `Inside' instead of `Begin'; see Table ). We could expect that complementing the BERT-based model with a CRF layer on top would help enforce the emission of valid sequences, alleviating this kind of errors and further improving its results.
